lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters located posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a roughly equidistant grid-like arrangement along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Indistinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating diffuse anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature originating posterior to the branchial region, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-based low-intensity pixels on the ventral side.
